The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 in the 'Task' worksheet returned #NAME? instead of the expected float values (e.g., H46 expected -1.7216, got #NAME?). This typically indicates the use of an unrecognized function name or a malformed formula string in the openpyxl workbook generation. Avoid using Excel functions that require specific add-ins or ensure all named ranges and functions are standard and correctly spelled.
